lines.text: Absalom gets a chariot, horses, and fifty men to run ahead, then says the king has no deputy.
Absalom wishes to be appointed judge, kisses those who bow to him, and steals the hearts of Israel's men.
After four years, Absalom asks to go to Hebron to fulfill a vow made while living in Gath.
Absalom sends spies to announce his reign at the horn, and two hundred men from Bethlehem go along innocently.
While Absalom offers sacrifices, he sends for Ahithophel the Gilonite, and his following keeps increasing.
